import sys

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    c = list(s)
    ans = 0
    r = len(c)
    while r > 0:
        l = r - 1
        while l >= 0 and c[l] == c[r - 1]:
            l -= 1
        if ((r - l - 1) & 1) == 0:
            ans += 1
        r = l + 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
